How it works

Bring the busywork together.

  1. Map one repeatable task. Define its trigger, inputs and the result you need.
  2. Connect the right tools. Decide which steps can run automatically and which need a person.
  3. Review, then repeat. Keep approvals and a clear record of each run.
Use cases

A few places to start.

  • Document intake: collect a file, extract key fields and route it for review.
  • Email triage: label incoming requests and prepare a draft response.
  • Approvals: send a reminder when a decision is waiting.

Illustrative workflows, not customer results. No apps are connected in this template.
